notes: Reports: three new screens. 📈 Sales Analysis — sales of all years in charts: year by year, month by month (year against year), top buyers and items with last year marked, firms, new buyers and buyers who have not bought this year; filters for firm, item, buyer, MT or ₹. Buyer Chart — every buyer × April…March of a year with total, last year and change (new / none yet / ▲▼ %), darker cells = more, search, sort and export. 🔮 Expected Orders — studies past orders: for each buyer the usual gap and quantity, the next order date (late / due now / later / stopped buying, seasonal buyers by their months), and the expected MT for the next 6 months and items for the next 3, against last year. Click any buyer for its years, months, items and last orders.
